meaning:
βασκαίνω,
[in LXX: Deu.28:54, 56 (רעע), Sir.14:6, 8*.]
1. to slander (Dem.).
2. to blight by the evil eye, to fascinate, bewitch: Gal.3:1.
† (AS)

elsewhere.note: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified?
